Patient Fund Participatory Allocation PROJECT CARDS ARE SYNTHETIC
A 10% share of every gross claim is routed to this fund. This prototype distributes configured round pools using squared vote weights.
Privacy notice: Advocate registration signs and emits a stable credential hash. This creates a linkage correlation risk for on-chain identity. Refer to OPEN_DESIGN_DECISIONS.md for active policy discussion.
Scarcity and care-continuity disclaimer: The Patient Fund operates as a ledger allocation engine for matching shares. It does not track, verify, or guarantee physical inventory, delivery, pharmacy stock, clinical outcomes, or patient access. Refer to SCARCITY_GOVERNANCE.md and CARE_CONTINUITY.md.
